title: 2023 Select #96 Will Levis Tennessee Titans Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a single Will Levis 2023 Select Rookie Concourse Level #96 RC trading card featuring the player in his Tennessee Titans uniform. The card is made of high-quality card stock and is an original, licensed reprint from the manufacturer, Select. It is a modern era sports trading card, with a National Football League (NFL) league theme and an English language text.

The card comes with several features, including being serial numbered, FOTL, Optic, Rookie Ticket, Rated Rookie, Ticket, Donruss Optic, First Off The Line, Rookie, Premium, Basketball, Auto, Contenders, Donruss, Premium Edition, On Card, Purple Stars, Contenders Basketball, and Refractor. It is a perfect addition to any sports trading card collection and is a must-have for fans of Will Levis and the Tennessee Titans.
